questions.prompt: Blood donation camps are held across India. Explain why donated blood is so valuable, and suggest one way to encourage more young adults to donate when they turn 18.
questions.modelAnswer: Blood cannot be manufactured, and it is needed for accident victims, surgeries, childbirth and patients with conditions like thalassaemia who need regular transfusions. Each donation can help more than one person because it is separated into red cells, plasma and platelets. Ideas: organise college donation drives with friends, share stories of people who were helped, explain that donation is safe and that the body replaces the blood, and recognise donors with certificates or apps.
rubric: It can't be manufactured / helps several people
